'''Siddiq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an importer at a [[Unidentified Mandalorian shipping company/Legends|shipping company]] in the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==Biography==
[[File:SiddiqDoesntKnowHowBadWikiaSucks-Corruption.png|thumb|left|200px|Siddiq relaxing in his office]]
Siddiq worked at a [[Unidentified Mandalorian shipping company/Legends|shipping company]]. The man got involved with a [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] smuggling ring that delivered supplies to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As part of the operations, he bribed a [[Unidentified Sundari school superintendent|Mandalorian school superintendent]] to import [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]].

He freely admitted to the connection when caught by a task force led by [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], claiming his corporate connections gave him immunity from prosecution, and supplied them with information about the smuggler's timetables and port of call.

==Behind the scenes==
Siddiq is voiced in the [[Clone Wars: Season Three|Clone Wars]] series by [[Corey Burton]].<ref name="Corruption Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref>
